snippet.title: Video Buddy Interactive Segments (Jim Henson's Muppet Babies: What's New at the Zoo?)
snippet.description:
I bought this Video Buddy tape from Goodwill over a decade ago. Each Video Buddy Interactive cassette has segments that feature the Video Buddy character asking the child viewer questions during the show, and they answer by pushing one or two colorful buttons on the Video Buddy console.

These segments cover what happened in an episode of "Jim Henson's Muppet Babies": "What's New at the Zoo?"

© 1985 Marvel Productions, Henson Associates
© 1999 Interactive Learning Group

Capture software: Canopus ADVC-110 and WinDV
Editing software: Adobe Premiere Pro

Disclaimer: I do not own any content in this video. This is uploaded for archival, educational, and research purposes.
